card.text: HD 39091 b was found in 2001 by Anglo-Australian Telescope by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Pi Mensae b"
sources.quote: Pi Mensae b, also known as HD 39091 b, is an extrasolar planet approximately 60 light-years away in the constellation of Mensa.

introduction.text: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 39091. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Damasso et al. 2020's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.
